---
title: "Past Papers"
---

Every TMUA question ever published, in one table. Nine sittings — the early specimen papers and
2016 to 2023 — each with worked answers and an answer key.

This archive is **complete and closed**: since the test went on screen in 2024, no further papers are
released ([why](../about/format.qmd#what-changed-in-2024)). 360 questions is all there is, so spend
them deliberately — keep two or three recent sittings unseen for timed mocks near the test date.

All links go to the official UAT-UK files. To keep a local copy, run `bash scripts/fetch_resources.sh`
from the repository root; the PDFs land in `_resources/past_papers/` and are not committed.

::: {.callout-note}
## A note on the 2016 papers and the specimen papers

These predate the settled format and read slightly differently from 2019 onwards — the specimen
papers in particular are labelled "practice paper" in their own worked answers. Use them, but treat
**2021–2023 as the best model of what the live test now asks**, and save those for late practice.
:::
